title: Enhance Quantum Teleportation with Multi-Axis Measurement
summary: Quantum teleportation is a cornerstone of quantum information processing, enabling the nonlocal transmission of quantum states across arbitrary distances using shared entanglement and classical communication. While the standard protocol typically employs Z-basis Bell-state measurements, this fixed-basis approach limits flexibility in practical quantum networks, where dynamic operations, hardware variability, and advanced communications demand alternative measurement bases.
